passages.translationText: Act so that the maxim of thy will can always at the same time hold good as a principle of universal legislation.
passages.interpretiveNote: 纯粹实践理性的基本法则要求意志的准则能够同时作为普遍立法的原则，而不是由欲望对象或经验利益决定。
